meta.name: make-com
meta.description: Expert-level Make.com automation platform guidance covering scenario design, API integration, AI agents, Make Bridge, error resilience, performance optimization, enterprise observability, and Blueprint JSON structure for scenario recreation. Use for any workflow automation, integration, or orchestration challenge including fix-and-flip property analysis and scenario programmatic building.

copy.tagline: 构建跨应用自动化流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你常为多个系统间来回搬运数据而烦恼
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often find yourself moving data back and forth between multiple systems.

howto.what: Claude 会变成 Make.com 向导:讲解模块/触发器/数据存储,帮忙设计流程、连接应用、处理报错,还能给出 API 或蓝图示例。
howto.when: 当你说到 Make.com,或提出自动化、集成、编排等需求时触发。

say.text: 设计 Make 场景:Webhook 写入 Google Sheets。
say.note: 你会得到分步搭建建议和模块选择。

say.text: Make 的 HTTP 请求报错 429,怎么配置重试和退避?
say.note: 会解释错误处理路由的设置方法。

say.text: 用 Make API 批量暂停所有场景,给个 curl 示例。
say.note: 会提供调用场景管理接口的代码。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude acts as a Make.com guide: explains modules, triggers, data stores, helps design automation flows, connect apps, handle errors, and provides API or blueprint examples.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention Make.com or ask about automation, integration, or orchestration needs.

say_en.text: Design a Make scenario: webhook writes to Google Sheets.
My Make HTTP request gets 429 errors. How to configure retries and backoff?
Give a curl example to pause all Make scenarios via API.
